85a4f0e08762f6ee.description: The Video Content Producer brings KAUST’s stories to life in post-production — shaping raw footage into polished, brand-aligned content that communicates the University’s research, people, and mission to audiences across digital and institutional channels. The role combines strong editorial judgement with technical expertise across editing, colour grading, and motion graphics. Working from production briefs under the direction of the Multimedia and Brand Production Manager, the Video Content Producer manages video projects from creative concept through to final delivery, contributes actively to pre-production planning, and serves as the team’s primary owner of motion graphics and 2D animation. The role requires a strong editorial sensibility, precise technical craft, and the discipline to manage multiple projects simultaneously to tight deadlines. The Video Content Producer is expected to engage proactively in the team’s creative planning pipeline, maintain rigorous DAM and workflow discipline, and bring genuine creative investment to every production. Occasional out-of-office hours working will be required, for which overtime will be paid. Key Responsibilities Pre-Production Review and analyse production briefs and participate in briefing sessions with relevant stakeholders. Contribute to storyboards, editorial structures, mood boards, and creative references. Identify and retrieve suitable archival footage and licensed media assets. Coordinate with production teams regarding shoot requirements, technical specifications, and footage handover. Editing and Post-Production Edit and produce video content including documentaries, interviews, promotional videos, research communications, and social media content. Apply transitions, motion graphics, visual effects, and animations. Produce 2D motion graphics and animated sequences. Perform professional colour correction and colour grading. Mix and master audio, including music, voice-over, dialogue, and ambient sound. Prepare final video projects in appropriate formats for web, social media, YouTube, LED screens, and other channels. Manage multiple editing projects while maintaining quality and meeting delivery deadlines. Project Management and Stakeholder Coordination Manage assigned video projects from creative concept through final delivery. Maintain clear communication with stakeholders regarding project requirements and timelines. Provide creative guidance and constructive feedback on video requirements. Maintain project schedules and proactively identify delivery or resourcing risks. Asset Management and Workflow Upload and organize production assets within defined timelines. Apply proper metadata, tags, and naming conventions. Maintain organized project files, footage, and finished assets within servers and DAM systems. Track production activities, tasks, edit notes, comments, and deliverables using Asana or equivalent project management tools. Maintain editing workstations and software and report technical or licensing issues when required. Creative Contribution Participate in creative planning sessions and contribute editorial and motion graphics ideas. Stay updated with emerging trends, techniques, and tools in video editing and post-production. Actively contribute to the editorial quality and visual impact of final productions Qualifications Undergraduate or postgraduate degree in Film-making, Media Production, or a related discipline. Additional training or certification in colour grading, motion graphics, or post-production workflows is desirable. Experience Minimum 5 years of professional experience as a Video Editor within a large organization or creative agency. Strong portfolio demonstrating editorial range and high-quality post-production work. Demonstrated experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Proven experience in Adobe After Effects, including 2D animation and typographic sequences. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously and working under tight deadlines. Experience in institutional, corporate, or higher education video production is desirable. Experience with 3D animation software such as Cinema 4D or Blender is an advantage. Familiarity with Avid Media Composer is desirable. Experience working alongside or directing camera operators during location productions is an advantage. Technical Skills Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects. Strong knowledge of colour science, colour grading workflows, and LUT management. Competence in audio mixing and sound design. Knowledge of video/audio formats, codecs, and multi-platform delivery specifications. Familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM) systems and metadata standards. Experience using Asana or equivalent project management tools. High IT literacy across Windows and macOS environments. Additional Requirements A portfolio or showreel of previous video editing work is required. Ability to work outside regular office hours when production schedules require it. Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail, creativity, communication, organization, and teamwork skills.

85e8333e6ef4fe66.description: The Community & Startups Coordinator supports the engagement, coordination, and overall experience of founders and startups participating in the accelerator program. The role focuses on building an active and connected startup community by coordinating founder engagement activities, community initiatives, and program events. Working closely with the accelerator team, the coordinator helps create a positive founder experience by ensuring smooth communication, supporting community-building initiatives, and coordinating the logistics and execution of program activities throughout the accelerator journey. Responsibilities Act as the day-to-day point of contact for founders and startups throughout the accelerator program. Coordinate founder onboarding, communications, engagement activities, and key program milestones. Build strong relationships with founders and maintain an active and connected startup community. Coordinate workshops, meetups, networking sessions, peer-learning activities, and community initiatives. Support founder engagement by connecting startups with mentors, resources, internal teams, and relevant program activities. Coordinate event logistics including registration, venues, catering, transportation, accommodation, schedules, invitations, and materials. Maintain accurate founder, startup, attendance, feedback, and engagement records in CRM and program management systems. Collect founder feedback and participation data to support reporting and continuous improvement. Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Events, and accelerator teams to ensure smooth program delivery. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Minimum 2+ years of experience in community management, startup programs, accelerator operations, or event coordination. Experience coordinating events, logistics, workshops, meetups, and multiple activities simultaneously. Experience working with startup ecosystems, innovation programs, founder communities, or accelerator programs is highly desirable. Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and communication skills. Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CRM, and project/program management tools. Passion for startups, entrepreneurship, innovation, and community building. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

85f2120e30a8bc41.description: The Safety Specialist will support the Safety Lead in implementing and maintaining occupational health and safety programs across KAUST facilities, operations, maintenance activities, construction works, and projects . The role will focus on field inspections, audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, safety documentation, contractor engagement, training, corrective action tracking, and compliance with ISO 45001, HSE policies, and applicable regulatory requirements . The position requires a strong field-oriented HSE professional who can identify hazards, evaluate risks, provide practical safety guidance, investigate incidents, and work effectively with facility owners, project teams, contractors, and service providers. Key Responsibilities HSE Program Implementation: Support the Safety Lead in implementing and continuously improving risk-based safety programs across facilities, operations, maintenance, construction, and projects. Safety Inspections & Audits: Conduct risk-based site inspections, safety audits, compliance evaluations, and field verifications to ensure HSE requirements are being followed. Risk Assessment: Perform hazard identification and risk assessments and verify that appropriate control measures are implemented and effective. Safety Documentation Review: Review HSE documents including risk assessments, method statements, safety plans, permits-to-work, lifting plans, excavation plans, confined-space controls, electrical work procedures, and MOC documentation. Incident Investigation: Investigate or support investigations of accidents, injuries, incidents, and near misses, identify root causes, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Corrective Action Tracking: Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from inspections, audits, investigations, and observations, ensuring timely closure and escalation of overdue actions. HSE Training & Awareness: Develop and deliver safety training, toolbox talks, workshops, permit-to-work training, and awareness programs to improve employee and contractor competency. Stakeholder & Contractor Support: Provide practical HSE guidance to facility owners, project teams, contractors, service providers, and other stakeholders to support safe execution of activities. HSE Reporting & Data Analysis: Collect and analyze HSE data, KPIs, inspection findings, audit results, incident trends, and corrective action status, providing reports and recommendations to management. Safety Culture & Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, intervene in unsafe activities, communicate lessons learned, maintain accurate HSE records, and support compliance with ISO 45001, regulations, policies, procedures, and industry best practices. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Science, or a related safety discipline is required. Professional Certification: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification is required. Incident Investigation: Certification or formal training in Incident Root Cause Analysis is required. HSE Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in occupational safety, facilities safety, construction safety, contractor management, projects, auditing, compliance, or related HSE functions. Risk Management: Strong experience in hazard identification, risk assessment, risk control, and implementation of risk-based safety programs. High-Risk Activities: Practical knowledge of safety controls for work at height, lifting operations, excavation, confined spaces, hot work, electrical work, and permit-to-work systems. ISO & Audit Knowledge: Working knowledge of ISO 45001, safety management systems, auditing, inspections, incident investigation, and corrective action management. Knowledge of ISO 19011 and ISO 31000 is an advantage. Safety Certifications: Additional recognized HSE qualifications such as CSP, CHST, NEBOSH Certificate/Diploma, IOSH, or equivalent are preferred. Train-the-Trainer certification is also an advantage. Communication & Reporting: Excellent English communication skills with the ability to prepare professional HSE reports, inspection records, investigation reports, presentations, and safety documentation.
